blocks.text: (a) Cracking

Cracking aik chemical process hai jis mein bare hydrocarbon molecules (aam taur par naphtha ya heavy oils) garmi se toot kar chhote aur zyada kaam ke molecules, jaise alkenes, ban jate hain. Yeh is liye zaruri hai ke ethene aur propene, jo halke (chhote) molecules hain, plastics aur artificial rubber banane ka sab se bara raw material hain. Cracking ke do bare tareeqe hain: thermal cracking aur catalytic cracking.
Thermal Cracking

Is mein bohat zyada temperature (aam taur par 450 °C se 750 °C) aur zyada pressure se carbon-carbon bonds tore jate hain. Koi catalyst nahi hota, is liye bohat energy lagti hai. Is se aam taur par alkenes zyada miqdar mein bante hain, jo plastic industry ke liye ahem hai. Maslan lambi chain wala alkane decane (C₁₀H₂₂) garmi se toot kar octane aur ethene deta hai:
Catalytic Cracking

Catalytic cracking zyada efficient (kam kharche mein zyada kaam) hai aur modern refineries mein zyada use hoti hai. Is mein catalyst dala jata hai (aam taur par zeolites yani aluminosilicates, ya silica-alumina), jo reaction ki activation energy (reaction shuru karne ke liye zaruri energy) bohat kam kar deta hai. Is liye process kam temperature (taqreeban 500 °C) aur kam pressure par ho jata hai, energy bachti hai aur products par behtar control milta hai.
Misal: heavy fraction naphtha ko catalyst ki maujoodgi mein crack kar ke zyada maang wale petrochemicals banaye jate hain. Is reaction se aam taur par chhoti chain wale alkenes ka mixture milta hai:

blocks.alt: Oopar thermal cracking: decane (C10H22) ki zigzag chain aathwen aur nauwen carbon ke darmiyan surkh dashed lakeer se kat'ti hai aur octane (C8H18) + ethene (C2H4) banti hai. Neeche catalytic cracking: naphtha catalyst ke saath ethene (C2H4) + propene (C3H6) deta hai.

blocks.text: b) Reforming

Reforming aik refining process hai jo hydrocarbons ki molecular structure ko nayi tarteeb deta hai. Cracking mein molecules toot'te hain, lekin reforming mein seedhi chain wale (straight-chain) alkanes branched (shakhon wale) ya cyclic (aromatic, ring wale) structure mein badal jate hain.

Reforming ka asal maqsad fuel ki quality behtar karna hai: kam octane wali seedhi chains ko zyada octane wale branched ya aromatic fuels mein badalna, taake engine knocking (engine mein khat khat) na ho.
Reforming ke reactions yeh hain:
1. Isomerisation (branched hydrocarbons banana)

2. Cyclization (cyclic hydrocarbons banana)
Seedhi chain wale hydrocarbons ko ring (cyclic) compounds mein badla jata hai, maslan:
3. Aromatic hydrocarbons banana (kitab ka naam: Dehydrocoupling)

Is step mein hydrogen nikal jati hai aur aromatic compounds bante hain. Is se ahem chemical base materials bante hain, maslan BTX (benzene, toluene aur xylene), jo plastics, dyes aur synthetic fibres ki bunyaad (building blocks) hain. Maslan hexane, jo 6 carbon ki seedhi chain hai, mazboot (stable) aromatic ring mein badal jata hai aur hydrogen gas qeemti by-product (saath milne wali cheez) ke taur par nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is equation par '(cyclohexane to benzene)' likhti hai. Lekin C₆H₁₄ hexane hai, aur equation hexane ke liye balanced hai, is liye sahi label '(hexane to benzene)' hai. Cyclohexane se shuru karein to equation C₆H₁₂ → C₆H₆ + 3H₂ hogi. Kitab is step ko 'dehydrocoupling' kehti hai; is ka aam naam dehydrocyclisation ya aromatisation hai (dehydrocoupling alag reaction hai jis mein do molecules hydrogen nikal kar jurte hain).

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein, har aik hexane ki zigzag chain se: 1. isomerisation -> iso-hexane (2-methylpentane), C6H14 -> C6H14; 2. cyclisation -> cyclohexane + H2, C6H14 -> C6H12 + H2; 3. dehydrocoupling (aromatic), Pt catalyst, heat -> benzene + 4H2, C6H14 -> C6H6 + 4H2.

blocks.text: Quick Check 31.4

blocks.prompt: a) Modern petroleum refineries mein catalytic cracking zyada kyun use hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh zyada efficient hai: catalyst activation energy kam karta hai, is liye process kam temperature (taqreeban 500 °C) aur kam pressure par chalta hai, energy bachti hai aur products par behtar control milta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Agar diesel ya kerosene jaise bare hydrocarbons se ethene aur propene jaise zyada alkenes chahiye hon to kaun sa cracking tareeqa behtar hai aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Thermal cracking, kyunke kitab ke mutabiq is se aam taur par alkenes zyada miqdar (high percentage) mein bante hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Reforming mein hexane benzene aur hydrogen mein badalta hai. Hydrogen ko qeemti by-product kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen saaf fuel hai jis ki specific energy bohat zyada (120 MJ/kg) hai, aur yeh kaam ka raw material bhi hai, maslan ammonia banane ke liye.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Cracking: bare molecules se chhote molecules aur alkenes.
Thermal: 450-750 °C, catalyst nahi; catalytic: zeolites, taqreeban 500 °C.
Reforming: isomerisation, cyclization, aromatic banana (C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₆ + 4H₂).
